prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1495; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving home on a two-lane road in Conroe, Texas. It was late afternoon and the road was wet from a light rain.
Q: What happened right before impact?
A: A pickup came over the center line into my lane. I braked and turned right, but we still collided nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour, but my head snapped forward and back.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: Yes, the driver airbag went off. My car was still drivable, so I pulled onto the shoulder.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: The paramedics checked me at the scene, then I went to the emergency room. They diagnosed a concussion. I've had headaches, sensitivity to light, and trouble concentrating since then.
Q: Are you currently under a doctor's care?
A: Yes, I'm seeing a physician and I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as I can.
Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?
A: I don't think so, but I was dazed for a few minutes and I don't remember the exact moment of impact.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Only that I'm still having symptoms, and I'm worried about missing work while I recover.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
